pinned_data_date_range.source: DERIVED_DATASET_MANIFEST_R2_RUN_38126168547.json; manifest says encrypted_only=true and these bounds must be verified against decrypted eligible timestamps before any fit

return_convention.equality_rule: flat when absolute simple return <= 1e-8; exclude flat values from directional two-class scoring and report each exclusion count
return_convention.no_tuning: flat tolerance cannot be changed after outer validation metrics are produced

labels.definition: sign of NIFTY spot simple return from forecast decision price to spot price 30 minutes later
labels.session_requirement: decision and target endpoint must both be inside the same official NSE trading session; no overnight carry
labels.flat_treatment: exclude from directional two-class metrics; report exclusion counts by fold/source

labels.definition: sign of NIFTY spot simple return from one official session close to the next official session close
labels.session_requirement: one target observation per eligible exchange session at the registered closing decision time; next official session supplies the target
labels.flat_treatment: exclude from directional two-class metrics; report exclusion counts by fold/source

common_rules.timezone: Asia/Kolkata (IST); session boundaries from an official exchange calendar pinned before label generation
common_rules.decision_time: timestamp of the forecast row; every feature must be available at or before this timestamp
common_rules.price_provenance: NIFTY spot/index observations only for labels; option/derived features may be predictors but never substitute for the target spot close
common_rules.intraday_sessions: label endpoint must fall within the same trading session; exclude overnight windows
common_rules.positional_sessions: next-session close-to-close endpoint; ensure no overlapping target horizon is counted twice
common_rules.purge_embargo: one complete exchange session purged immediately before validation and the first complete validation session embargoed from scored rows; purge any training label interval overlapping validation
common_rules.missing_target_rows: exclude and count; BLOCK a fold if target-pair missingness exceeds 1% of session-eligible rows
common_rules.minimums: use exact sample/class/missingness minima from PREDICTION_PREREGISTRATION_V2_R2.json; do not relax or move fold dates after viewing results
common_rules.holdout: no untouched holdout access; fresh forward phase requires a separate gate

execution_gate: DRAFT ONLY; no empirical fitting until the independent tester approves the label manifest, compatibility matrix, preregistration and synthetic runner.
